system.description:
Shift into liquid, gas, incorporeal, or energy for dramatic movement and access.

  • Level 1: Liquid state, short duration
  • Level 2: Liquid state, long duration
  • Level 3: Gaseous state, short duration
  • Level 4: Gaseous state, long duration
  • Level 5: Incorporeal state, short duration
  • Level 6: Incorporeal state, long duration
  • Level 7: Energy state, short duration
  • Level 8: Energy state, long duration
